about.name: Prof. Nandini Rao
about.title: Founder & Head of Academics
about.bio: Prof. Nandini began tutoring five students in a Marine Lines flat and built Bright Minds on one idea: no child should feel lost in a crowded batch. Every class is capped at fifteen students, every student sits a weekly test, and parents receive a simple one-page progress note every month. Her team of subject teachers hold open doubt-solving hours every evening, so questions never wait until the next lecture.

faqs.q: Can we attend a free demo class before joining?
faqs.a: Yes. Every course has a free demo lecture. Book a slot below, pick a subject, and bring your child's latest report card so the teacher can suggest the right batch.

faqs.q: What is the maximum batch size?
faqs.a: We cap every batch at 15 students so each child gets individual attention. Once a batch is full, we open a new one rather than adding more desks.

faqs.q: Do you teach the SSC, CBSE and ICSE boards?
faqs.a: Yes. Batches are board-specific for Std 8 to 10 and HSC Commerce, so the syllabus, sample papers and test patterns match what your child will face.
Students take a weekly test. Parents get a one-page monthly report on WhatsApp covering attendance, test scores and teacher comments, and can book a one-to-one call.

faqs.q: What are the fees and can they be paid in instalments?
faqs.a: Fees start at the monthly price shown against each course. Quarterly and half-yearly plans carry a small discount, and the first instalment is refundable if you leave within 7 days.
Weekday batches run from 8 AM to 8 PM, Saturdays until 5 PM, and Sunday mornings are for doubt-solving and mock tests. Evening batches are timed to finish before the 8:30 PM local trains.
